adapterId.description: The adapter id uniquely identifies an adapter instance.
adapterId.label: Adapter Id

metrics.description: Live metrics object for this adapter instance (`valueAccessor` adapter_metrics). Active adapter pointer is loaded under adapter_id_anchor_lock; metrics contents are not deep-copied. Counters may change while held. The accessor holds an instance reference until the caller pool is released, so a concurrent stop drains instead of destroying the object. Do not cache beyond that pool. NULL when no active instance.
metrics.label: Metrics

properties.description: Live object with selected conf properties plus runtime properties for this adapter instance (`valueAccessor` adapter_properties). Pointer loaded under adapter_id_anchor_lock; not deep-copied on get. The accessor holds an instance reference until the caller pool is released, so a concurrent stop drains instead of destroying the object. Typically absent on the active anchor after full stop.
properties.label: Properties

referenceCount.description: Active instance reference count, copied under adapter_id_anchor_lock (valueAccessor adapter_reference_count). Safe scalar snapshot for admin/debug.
referenceCount.label: Reference Count

serviceId.brief: The id of the associated service
serviceId.description: The id of the associated service. The URI of the service is '/afw/_AdaptiveService_/' followed by this id.
serviceId.label: Service Id

stopping.description: Reference counts of stopping instances, snapshotted under adapter_id_anchor_lock (valueAccessor stopping_adapter_instances).
stopping.label: Stopping Instances
